authority: This JSON is authoritative. The Markdown twin is explanatory and cannot weaken it.
purpose: Find 2-3 profitable-after-cost candidates for an isolated protected PAPER/testnet cohort without reusing the viewed holdout.

candidate_selection_disclosure.basis: Previously viewed development near-misses selected because they were positive after costs and failed only the frozen sample-size gate.
candidate_selection_disclosure.multiplicity_rule: Register all three new identities and retain every prior tested candidate in the program ledger. Report raw and Holm-adjusted inference as selection-bias diagnostics only; they are not promotion gates in this economic-screen pack and must never be described as confirmatory error control. Never erase rejected trials.

candidates.allowed_change: signal and time exits fill at the next tradable open; use the preregistered causal fold-start filter-eligible CORE-20

candidates.source_rule: strategies.py:sig_exp_mom_short with the preregistered 180-bar cap in research_evidence/prereg/trend_ema_mom_short.v1.json
candidates.allowed_change: add the already-preregistered 180-bar cap, fill signal/time exits at the next tradable open, and use the preregistered causal fold-start filter-eligible CORE-20
signal and time exits fill at the next tradable open; use the preregistered causal fold-start filter-eligible CORE-20

intrabar_rule.lineage: FBL-BT01 semantics from backtest.py path_points and walk_path, encoded here so later source edits cannot change this evaluation
intrabar_rule.gap_stop: if the bar opens at or beyond the stop, fill the entire remaining position at the open before any target, partial, breakeven, trail, or other event
intrabar_rule.both_stop_and_favourable_level: if the stop as frozen at the bar open lies inside the bar range, the stop wins for the candle and target/partial exits are suppressed even if the declared path reaches them first
intrabar_rule.monotonic_leg_order: otherwise fire reached levels in price order along each declared path leg
intrabar_rule.target_and_partial_reference_fill: fill at the frozen trigger level; a favourable gap receives no price improvement
intrabar_rule.partial_then_management: after a partial target, update position quantity once; breakeven or trail may ratchet only after the completed favourable path leg and can be hit only on a later adverse leg
intrabar_rule.trail_update: ratchet only after each completed path leg, never retroactively within that leg
intrabar_rule.signal_and_time_order: process the full intrabar path first; if still open, a signal or time decision fills only at its separately frozen next-open index
intrabar_rule.dca_or_pyramid: forbidden for all three candidates in this pack

management_semantics.entry_atr: ATR_entry is the candidate signal ATR at completed decision bar d when finite and positive; otherwise it is the engine ATR at d. No entry-bar high, low, close, or ATR may be read.
management_semantics.entry_price_basis: entry_exec is the adverse-slipped, frozen-tick-rounded executable price at entry index e; every initial management level and R below uses entry_exec, not the unslipped reference open
management_semantics.initial_quantity: qty_raw = risk_cash / R_price; apply leverage cap, then floor to frozen MARKET_LOT_SIZE step; skip rather than round up if minQty/minNotional fails, and refuse rather than clip if maxQty fails
management_semantics.level_precision: management trigger levels remain the exact formula values for causal touch ordering; only executable fill prices are adverse-rounded to the frozen tick by the cost rule
management_semantics.full_target: when tp_r exists, target = entry_exec + side_sign * tp_r * R_price and closes all remaining quantity
management_semantics.tp1: when tp1_r exists, tp1 = entry_exec + side_sign * tp1_r * R_price; requested close quantity = current_qty * tp1_frac
management_semantics.partial_quantity: for a partial only, floor requested close quantity to MARKET_LOT_SIZE step; if it becomes zero, send nothing, do not mark tp1 complete, and permit a later candle retry; after a fill, floor the remaining quantity to the same step
management_semantics.partial_dust: tp1 has no automatic dust-to-full-close conversion; full exits close all remaining model quantity. No take-profit ladder exists in this pack.
management_semantics.breakeven: when be_r exists and best_price reaches entry_exec + side_sign * be_r * R_price, tighten stop toward entry_exec only after that favourable path leg; never loosen it
management_semantics.trail: when trail_atr exists, after each completed path leg set candidate_stop = best_price - side_sign * trail_atr * ATR_prior_closed_bar, using engine ATR from bar i-1, then keep max(current_stop,candidate_stop) for long or min for short; never loosen and never apply retroactively within the leg
management_semantics.best_price: initialize to entry_exec; update to the most favourable reached point after each declared path leg
management_semantics.fill_accounting: partial and full fills use the single-count reference-price PnL, adverse slippage, fee, funding, and tick rules in costs

execution.actual_exchange_filters: checksum-bound Binance filters observed before each fold starts and frozen for that fold under exchange_filter_authority.v2.json

book_and_sizing.source: identity-defining causal-book deviation from tools/research/run_vwaprev_candidate.py APP_DEFAULTS and backtest.py open_pos: the legacy source sizes from realized cash at fill, while this contract sizes from the explicitly frozen causal marked-equity book at each next-open entry attempt; executable sizing is evidence, not a caller option
book_and_sizing.entry_attempt_phase: At bar open t, after settlements with funding_time < t, the causal mark snapshot and Cairo day-start roll, and every signal/time exit due at t, but before this symbol's entry fill, calculate its terms. Simultaneous requests are attempted sequentially in entry_priority. Intrabar stop/target/trail management for bar t occurs only after all due open exits, entry attempts, and funding_time == t settlements.
book_and_sizing.marked_equity_formula: settled_cash_equity + sum(side_sign * remaining_qty * (causal_mark - unslipped_reference_entry)) over open positions. settled_cash_equity starts at 500 and includes every earlier realized reference-price PnL, entry/exit fee, adverse slippage, signed funding settlement, and partial fill exactly once.
book_and_sizing.mark_timestamp_basis: For positions already open before t, causal_mark is the last checksum-verified 1h mark-price close whose availability timestamp is <= t. A position admitted at t uses its unslipped reference open as its mark for same-open sizing. No later mark or bar-t close/high/low may enter an entry attempt.
book_and_sizing.risk_cash_formula: At each symbol's entry-attempt phase, risk_cash = current marked candidate-book equity * 0.01. Earlier symbols at the same open reduce later marked equity by their settled entry fee and adverse slippage; their unrealized PnL is zero because their same-open mark is the unslipped reference open.
book_and_sizing.gross_open_notional_formula: sum(abs(remaining_qty * causal_mark)) over positions open at the entry attempt; positions admitted earlier at the same open use their unslipped reference open as causal_mark
book_and_sizing.leverage_notional_cap_formula: At each entry attempt, leverage_notional_cap = max(0, 10.0 * current marked candidate-book equity - current gross open notional); size the new position to no more than leverage_notional_cap / adverse executable entry before exchange-step flooring.
book_and_sizing.entry_priority: For simultaneous next-open entries, process symbols in the causal fold-start filter-eligible CORE-20 order derived from the checksum-verified PIT universe and exchange_filter_authority.v2.json; later symbols see earlier fills, entry costs, open-position count, and gross notional. Caller order cannot change this sequence.
book_and_sizing.daily_halt_timezone: Africa/Cairo resolved through the IANA timezone database for every timestamp
book_and_sizing.daily_halt_rule: The Cairo day is keyed by entry/exit fill timestamp t. At the first bar open t in a new Cairo calendar day, after funding_time < t is settled and existing positions receive the frozen causal mark snapshot, but before any fill at t or funding_time == t, freeze day_start_equity from marked_equity_formula and clear the prior day's latch. Process due signal/time exits at t, then test and latch the 8% threshold before the first entry attempt and again after every entry cost, funding settlement, partial exit, and final exit. Once latched, refuse all later new entries in that Cairo day; never block an exit or management action. Funding_time == t is settled after all same-open entry attempts, so positions entered at t receive it as required by entry_fill_time <= funding_time, and its equity effect can latch the halt only for later bars. Intrabar management follows that exact-time funding and can also latch the halt for later bars.
book_and_sizing.caller_override: forbidden; changing any value or formula creates a new contract and evaluation identity

costs.funding: checksum-verified actual Binance USD-M funding at every settlement t with entry_fill_time <= t < exit_fill_time, using the last causal verified mark
costs.funding_sign: signed_funding_cash = -signed_position_notional * funding_rate; therefore a positive rate is a receipt for a short and a debit for a long
costs.price_pnl_basis: gross_reference_price_pnl uses unslipped reference prices only; slipped executable prices are not used again in price P&L
costs.adverse_slippage_cash: sum the nonnegative cash difference between every reference fill and its adverse tick-rounded executable fill exactly once
costs.adverse_fill_rule: shift every buy fill upward and every sell fill downward by adverse_slippage_per_fill_bps, round to the frozen exchange tick against the strategy, then apply fees to the resulting notional
costs.cost_stress_rule: multiply fees, adverse slippage, and negative funding debits by the stress multiplier; positive funding credits remain at 1.0x and are never amplified

data.universe: causal_v3 fold-start filter-eligible CORE-20: for each PIT week take the first 20 ranked crypto members eligible under the fold's pre-start Binance filter snapshot
data.exchange_filter_authority_rule: latest snapshot with capture and Binance serverTime strictly before fold start; freeze for whole fold; missing authority is a metadata eligibility veto before market data, never an outcome deletion

split_rules.bar_index_model: Each fold has local bars 0..N-1 and end-exclusive index N. A signal decision at completed bar d fills entry at e=d+1.
split_rules.entry_eligibility_inequality: e >= L and e + H < N
split_rules.terminal_fill_inequality: every actual exit fill index x must satisfy e <= x < N

promotion_gates.incomplete_scope: Any missing causal fold-start filter authority, funding, mark, tradable next-open, or required report makes the entire candidate INCOMPLETE; incomplete rows may not be excluded from the denominator or reduced-sample promotion.

cohort.activation: default-OFF until independent evidence and Codex exact-head acceptance
cohort.loss_controls_required: RISK-LOSS-01 on master dc7f255 or descendant

stop_conditions: Any contract or candidate-rule byte change creates a new candidate and evaluation identity.
Any use of an exchange-rule snapshot captured at or after its fold start refuses the pack before market data.
Any read at or after 2026-09-28 refuses the pack before producing evidence.
A losing-after-cost candidate is rejected and receives no cohort risk.
No result may weaken a gate, select a fold, change a symbol set, or tune a parameter.
